lastCompletedStory.title: Reviewer backstops every file-size-budget ceiling raise

nextStoryContext: US-002 added a file-size-budget ceiling-raise justification check to both copies of the reviewer instruction file: a new '### Conventions' checklist bullet (each raised ceiling in scripts/file-size-budget.json must be argued as legitimate growth, not a symptom of a file that should have been split; an unjustified raise is CRITICAL/REQUEST CHANGES) plus an extension of the Layer B rubric's criterion-5 (project-conventions) PASS-when text to name the same check, so it is applied on every review via the existing rubric, not left as prose-only. The two copies were edited in their own existing style (dual-copy convention; .claude/ copy is cam-cli-specific, templates/ copy is the generic project template mirroring the file-size ratchet language already present in templates/agents/subagent-implementer.md), not verbatim-mirrored. embed-vendor was re-run and embed-vendor:check is clean.
